brief:
Israeli Occupation Forces killed five Palestinians between November 5 and 7, including two children and a woman, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported. Three additional Palestinians—including two female university students—died from wounds sustained in earlier Israeli attacks during the same period.

Heavy rains, strong winds, and low temperatures swept across the Gaza Strip as the attacks continued. Tens of thousands of tents sheltering displaced Palestinians were flooded by the weather.
dek: From 5 to 7 November 2026, Israeli Occupation Forces (IOF) killed five Palestinians, including two children and a woman, while three others, including two female university students, succumbed to injuries sustained earlier amid continued Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip. These attacks coincided with heavy rains, strong winds, and low temperatures across the Gaza Strip.
title: Israel kills eight Palestinians as rain floods displacement camps
